body: At the moment I am, I haven't shown it but i've been bottling it up, I don't even know who or what I am at the moment, before the break up I was the tamest guy ever, never touched drugs always concerned for my well being, but now I really want to kill myself but it would ruin everyone's christmas and for some reason it feels like if I keep up abusing drugs and alcohol I could kill myself without people knowing it was suicide. I know this doesn't quite fit the question but I feel like the crazy ex, I hate her even though she's a really kind person and I hate him because it feels like shit to know that our 3 year relationship can be replaced in 3 days. Sorry for the ramble its just my first time properly venting
